item.title: CK Flex Plex holds grand opening

item.description: A Chatham councillor's motion aimed at curbing renovictions within the municipality comes up for a vote Monday night.

item.description: Chatham-Kent's mayor wants students to know there is always a place for them to live a fulfilling life in their hometown.

item.title: Walpole Island joins legal fight against Ontario, federal bills
item.description: Walpole Island is one of five First Nations joining a legal fight against Ontario's Bill 5 and Ottawa's Bill C-5

item.title: Chatham hospital back running at full steam
